request.prompt: Animate this exact massive armored Ash Warden doing ONE heavy forward BODY CHARGE toward the camera SOUTH, then braking. Fixed top-down frontal camera, entire body and broad sword inside canvas. First spread boots wide, bend knees deeply, lower armored chest and tilt helmet forward, both gauntlets grip ONE sword handle LOW beside the hip, blade trails backward, NEVER overhead. Then a powerful rear boot push drives the chest forward into a strongly leaning shoulder-first dash; front knee drives forward, trailing leg extends hard backward. Hold a distinct low armored charging pose, torn ash tabard and dry branches trail behind by inertia. Then thrust one supporting boot forward, bend both knees under enormous weight, chest overshoots and sword balances braking, finally settle into original low sword combat stance. Clear anticipation, explosive leg push, sustained forward body lean and heavy separate braking. This is NOT walking, NOT running cycle, NOT sword slash or overhead cleave. Both hands remain touching same handle, single broad greatsword kept low throughout. Preserve exact helmet, charcoal bulky armor, orange cracks, branches and ash tabard. No particles, dust, flames, trails, ground, blur or teleport. Root stays centered; game engine will translate character.
